Dr. Gautam Hazarika, Chief Operating Officer of ILS Hospitals Agartala, along with Mr. Tanuj Saha, Head of Operations, participated in the distribution of these essential resources. We extend our gratitude to Corporator Mr. Pradeep Chanda, Zonal Chairman of the North Zone AMC, for joining us in our efforts to assist those in need.

title: Road safety barriers
excerpt: The huge numbers of private vehicles, heterogeneous traffic and limited road space have led to the p...
heading: Road safety barriers
body_html:
The huge numbers of private vehicles, heterogeneous traffic and limited road space have led to the problem of congestion on the Indian city roads. The situation is no different in Kolkata & Howrah. ILS Hospitals is thankful to Bidhannagar Traffic Police & Howrah City Police for allowing to place Road Safety Barriers.

Safety measures and long term recommendations are made to improve the road safety situation of Kolkata & Howrah by arranging Road Safety Barriers at Bidhannagar in Kolkata area and at Golabari in Howrah area under supervision of Bidhannagar Traffic Police & Howrah City Police. Road safety barriers increase visibility of the road edge and safe travel path, prevent breakthrough and create a strong barrier between hazards and the road.

title: Employee children educational assistance
excerpt: Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) is the medium through which we can give back to society. The A...
heading: Employee children educational assistance
body_html: Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) is the medium through which we can give back to society. The Act provides mandatory contribution towards CSR with education being specified as an eligible activity. The role of CSR in supporting child education can play a very vital role in creating positive growth in the society. CSR in education has involved steps like promoting education, providing scholarships, increasing access to education and higher education, gender equality in education. Here in GPT Group we also try to maintain this novel initiative by extending educational support for our employees.

We do expect more help from you to continue caring. Please help us to spread this message among others’ – Mon Majhi Alzheimer’s and Dementia Day Care & Residential Center, Kolkata.

heading: Bin distribution
body_html: We believe in serving and contributing to the well-being of communities, in the truest sense. We understand that alone, we can do little, but collectively, we can do so much more. Sanitation and sustainability help build clean, healthy communities. We have partnered with Ad My Bin to create awareness about best practices in solid and waste management that will help reduce health risks.

heading: Blanket distribution
body_html: GPT Group has been also engaged in the distribution of blankets especially to the poor and homeless people during the winter months. Our annual Blanket Donation Campaign is a testament to our commitment. Our mission is simple yet impactful: distribute high-quality warm blankets, essential dry rations, and dignity kits to those calling the streets their home.

excerpt: Donating blood is a righteous activity that can save many people's lives. All individual's social du...
heading: Blood donation
body_html: Donating blood is a righteous activity that can save many people’s lives. All individual’s social duty is blood donation above all casts and religions. We support this cause and seek the contribution of the people to promote blood donation camps. All the employees participated in the activity and many of them donated blood. Every drop of blood is like a breath for someone! Donate blood.

title: Child orphanage home
excerpt: GPT Group supported the orphanage house Aashar Alo, Kolkata and spent time with the orphan children....
heading: Child orphanage home
body_html: GPT Group supported the orphanage house Aashar Alo, Kolkata and spent time with the orphan children. Food, refreshments were arranged and small gifts were also presented to orphan kids. Moreover, special entertainment programmes were organized for the children such as fun game segments. One of the other highlights of the visit was to gift stationary materials.
